title: TrojanWhisper: Evaluating Pre-trained LLMs to Detect and Localize Hardware Trojans

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates potential training data bias (specifically memorization of open-source benchmarks) by applying code perturbation techniques like variable name obfuscation and design restructuring to the test dataset. It then compares the models' detection performance on the original versus the obfuscated code to determine if success is due to reasoning or memorization of the training data.
